title: Open Identity Interpretation v0.1
description: Read-only intermediate representation extracted from free-form player identity expression.

display_name.description: A name only when the player explicitly supplies one.

candidate_facts.description: Directly expressed candidate identity, occupation, background, or experience facts; not yet Grounded.

candidate_claims.description: Claims about royalty, divinity, special bloodline, external relationships, dragon control, or major history that need later Grounding.

traits.description: Explicit or directly implied non-numeric personal traits, at most five.

capability_hints.description: Conservative, non-numeric semantic capability hints grounded only in explicitly described experience.

identity_summary.description: A concise one- or two-sentence summary of the candidate identity, not a statement of World Truth.
